description: Gratuitous-ARP companion to ARP_04 — verify that DUT not only learns from a gratuitous ARP Response but actually uses the learned MAC as the Ethernet destination of subsequent UDP egress (RFC 826 §2.3 + arp_accept=1, end-to-end check)
approach:
[Objective]
Gratuitous ARP variant of ARP_04. The seeding stimulus is a gratuitous ARP Response (opcode 2, sender == target) instead of a Request; the verification is the same as ARP_04 — DUT's UDP datagram to HOST-1-IP must carry the learned MAC as its Ethernet destination. Confirms that gratuitous learning produces a usable cache entry, not a half-learned record.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: gratuitous ARP Response injected
   • opcode      = 2
   • sender IP   = HOST-1-IP
   • sender MAC  = MAC-ADDR1
   • target IP   = HOST-1-IP
   • target MAC  = MAC-ADDR1
   ⇒ DUT must add <HOST-1-IP, MAC-ADDR1> to its ARP cache.

2. Tester → DUT: SOME/IP Subscribe-Nack message
   ⇒ Stimulates DUT to send a UDP response back to HOST-1-IP.

3. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: UDP packet
      - destination MAC = MAC-ADDR1 (the learned value)   ← key check
   • DUT must NOT emit its own ARP Request before the UDP

[Pass condition]
Within the observation window, DUT (a) emits the UDP, (b) its destination MAC equals MAC-ADDR1 from step 1, and (c) no DUT-originated ARP Request precedes it.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_dut_did_arp_request — DUT emitted its own ARP Request (gratuitous learning ignored or entry expired)
• Fail_wrong_eth_dst — UDP sent but its Ethernet destination MAC differs from MAC-ADDR1 (entry exists but was not consumed)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the observation window

verdicts.Pass: DUT sent UDP using the gratuitous-learned MAC without an extra ARP Request — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_did_arp_request: DUT emitted its own ARP Request — gratuitous learning failed or entry expired (likely arp_accept=0)
verdicts.Fail_wrong_eth_dst: UDP was sent but its Ethernet destination did not match the learned MAC — entry exists but not used
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit UDP within the observation window — stimulus did not provoke egress
